column1: # Code table for despatches 039 + 045 (27 Oct 2026). Two codes occur: J91 = the Jan 1791 code (despatches 001-003;
# 039 section B, 045 part 1), D92 = the code of the 1792 Danzig letters (039 section A, 045 part 2).
# value = most frequent value (variants after "/"); firm = count of placements not marked [?];
# flag: "variant" = values differ only by case/diacritics/one containing the other (split or homophone spelling);
# CONFLICT = incompatible values for the same group in the same code (homophone, syllable overlap, misreading or bad split).
